title: Concept: Alt-Svc advertises a cleartext HTTP/2 alternative
description: An Alt-Svc advertisement offers h2c, the cleartext variant of HTTP/2, as an alternative service. A client that switches to it keeps the same origin semantics but loses TLS on every later request, so cookies and tokens for that origin cross the network unprotected.
applicability: Responses from services that publish alternative-service advertisements, including CDNs and HTTP/3 front ends.
risk: Later requests to the same origin may be downgraded to cleartext; MEDIUM severity because the header is an offer, not a completed downgrade.
